# Privathospitaler

Privathospitaler ("private hospitals") appear in the ADHD-databasens 2024 årsrapport as a distinct reporting category alongside public regional psychiatric departments, but the data submitted from this group is thin and repeatedly flagged by the steering group as too sparse to interpret reliably.

For Indikator 1 (somatic assessment), private hospitals reported a 0% completion rate, since zero somatic assessments were registered in their data [^src1]. The report notes that the reason for this is unknown, because no representative from the private hospitals attended the meeting where results were discussed — and it further notes that the very small number of patients on which this figure is based is itself striking and "vækker undring" (raises concern) [^src1].

This pattern of near-absent data recurs across several indicators. For Indikator 9 (psychotherapy within one year of treatment start, first reported for patients with treatment starting between 1 April and 31 July 2024), private hospitals reported 0 out of 3 qualifying courses, a rate of 0% (range 0–71) [^src2], and the report states that the almost non-existent number of courses reported from private hospitals makes it impossible to assess whether they meet the quality indicators [^src2]. For Indikator 10 (assessment of social support needs within 120 days, first reported this year), private hospitals reported 0 out of 10 courses, again 0% (range 0–31) [^src3], with the same caveat that the near-absent reporting volume prevents any meaningful evaluation [^src3].

By contrast, for a later indicator (Indikator 11, concerning ADHD medication within 120 days of starting a treatment package), private hospitals reported 9 out of 10 courses meeting the standard, a rate of 90% (range 55–100) [^src4], with individual facility results ranging between 83% and 100% [^src4]. Even here, though, the report repeats its standard caution that the almost non-existent number of reported courses makes it impossible to properly judge whether private hospitals meet the quality indicators [^src4].

One specific facility is identified within this category: Carelink Psykiatri Viborg is classified as a private hospital in the ADHD database [^src2].

Taken together, Privathospitaler functions in this report less as a well-characterized care provider and more as a data quality problem — a category whose low patient volumes and, in at least one instance, absent representation at the review meeting, undermine confidence in any of the reported percentages, whether they show 0% or 90%.
